name: x-dev-pipeline
description: Structured dev workflow with spec, adversarial risk review, task breakdown, execution, verify, qa-gate, fix loops, and audits.

interface.longDescription: Turn coding requests into a traceable workflow with spec capture, adversarial risk review, task breakdown, implementation, fact verification, risk-matched qa-gate review, fix loops, and independent audits.
defaultPrompt: x-req add dark mode toggle to settings page
x-req turn this feature request into a task package
x-verify run dev-report command list against the latest task
x-qa-gate review the current task with risk-routed reviewers
x-fix fix issues from the latest verify or qa-gate report
